name: REMAX Europe
description:
REMAX Europe Listings lets you search live REMAX property listings across 24 European countries and view the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery, without leaving the chat.

Ask in plain language for what you want: a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, or elevator / barrier-free access. Budgets in local currencies (HUF, PLN, RON, TRY, CHF, GBP, and more) are converted to EUR automatically, and a currency toggle lets you view prices in your own currency. Open any listing to see full details like photo carousel, key facts, description, and agent contact, right inside the chat, with a link through to the full page on remax.eu. Listing titles and descriptions can be translated into your language on demand.

Coverage (24 countries): Albania, Austria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Israel, Kosovo, K.K.T.C. (Northern Cyprus), Luxembourg, Malta, Montenegro, Poland, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Switzerland, and Türkiye.

The connector is read-only: it searches and displays public listings and never modifies data. It requires no account or login. The interface is available in 32 languages and follows the language you write in.

_published_faq.name: How do I add REMAX Europe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add REMAX Europe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://listings.remax.eu/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is REMAX Europe MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, REMAX Europe scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the REMAX Europe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: REMAX Europe provides these MCP tools: get_listing_detail and search_listings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to REMAX Europe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to REMAX Europe in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does REMAX Europe MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: REMAX Europe does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
REMAX Europe is developed by REMAX Europe. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
